introduction:
Applying for a new APL (Above Poverty Line) Ration Card in Rajasthan is a streamlined process under the Food and Civil Supplies Department. This service is specifically designed for newly married couples or families seeking to separate from an existing ration card to establish a new household.

The application can be submitted online via the eMitra Portal (emitra.rajasthan.gov.in) or by submitting physical forms directly to the local authorities.
quickFacts:
Quick Facts & Key Details
  • Purpose: Applying for a new APL (Above Poverty Line) Ration Card in Rajasthan.
  • Target Audience: Specifically for newly married couples or families separating from an existing ration card.
  • Relevant State: Rajasthan
  • Official Portals: eMitra Portal (emitra.rajasthan.gov.in) and Food and Civil Supplies Department, Rajasthan.
  • Form Type: Form - 1 (New Ration Card).
documentsRequired:
Documents Required

Note: Original documents must be scanned for online applications. Ensure all copies are clear and legible.
Mandatory Certificates & IDs
  • Marriage Registration Certificate: Mandatory if you are applying as a newly married couple.
  • NOC / Surrender Certificate: Name deletion certificate for both husband and wife from their respective parents' old ration cards.
  • Aadhaar Cards: Aadhaar copies for all family members to be added to the new card.
  • Duly Filled Application Form (Form 1): The physical paper form completely filled out, bearing a verified family photograph, and officially signed and stamped (sealed) by a Gram Sevak, Sarpanch, or Patwari.
Digital Files (For Online Application)
  • Head of Family's Photo: Passport-size photograph (Size: 10 KB to 20 KB).
  • Head of Family's Signature: Scanned signature (Size: 10 KB to 20 KB).
  • Scanned Application Form: Scanned PDF of the verified Application Form (Max size: 200 KB).
  • Scanned Enclosures: Scanned PDF of all other Enclosures/Documents combined (Max size: 400 KB).
onlineApplication:
Method 1: Apply Online (eMitra Kiosk / SSO Login)

If you are an eMitra kiosk user or applying online via SSO login, follow these step-by-step instructions:

  1. Log in: Log in to the eMitra Dashboard.
  2. Navigate to Utility: From the left menu, click on Search in Menu and select Utility.
  3. Select Service: In the "Avail Utility Service" search box, type "Ration Card" and select the service named: Ration - New Ration Card Form Filling (Form 1).
  4. Redirect to Portal: Click Search and then click Yes to be redirected to the third-party Food & Civil Supplies portal.
  5. Select BDO / Office: Select your District and the designated Office (e.g., Block Development Office / BDO) and click Continue.
  6. Submit Preliminary Form: A preliminary form will appear. Fill in your Block, Panchayat, Village, Applicant's Name, Father's Name, Address, Pin Code, and Mobile Number. Click Submit.
  7. Initiate New Form: You will be redirected to the main application page. From the dropdown near the top, click New, then click the Choose dropdown and select the entry you just created.
  8. Personal Information: Fill in the applicant's name (in Hindi and English), mother's name, father's name, spouse's name, gender, Date of Birth (DOB), and Aadhaar number.
  9. Address Details: Enter your Present Address. If your permanent address is the same, check the box "Permanent Address same as Present Address".
  10. Residence Details: Select your Residence Type (e.g., Own house, rented), the time period you have lived there, and Occupation Type. Re-enter your mobile number.
  11. Additional Details: Fill in Gas Connection Status (Single, Double, or No connection). Bank details are optional. Click Save.
  12. Family Description: The head of the family's details might show as incomplete. Click the Edit button next to their name. Enter their name, mother's/father's name in both Hindi and English, DOB, gender, and Aadhaar number. Click Update Member.
  13. Add Family Members: To add more members (like a spouse), click Add New Member and fill in their exact details as mentioned above.
  14. Upload Attachments: Scroll down and upload the Head of Family's photograph and signature in the specified sizes. Click Save.
  15. Proof of Enclosures: Under "Application Form", upload the scanned PDF of the physical form. Under "Upload Enclosures", upload the single PDF containing the NOCs, Aadhaar cards, and Marriage Certificate.
  16. Verify & Submit: Click the Verify button to submit the application to the respective BDO office.
offlineApplication:
Method 2: Apply Offline (Manual Verification Process)

If you do not have access to eMitra or wish to apply manually, follow the offline verification process:

  1. Obtain Form 1: Download the "New Ration Card Application Form (Form-1)" from the official Food Department website, or get a physical copy from a local eMitra center or Tehsil office.
  2. Fill the Form: Fill in all details carefully in Hindi/English, including family members' details, occupation, and address.
  3. Attach Photograph: Paste a passport-size photograph of the Head of the Family on the designated spot.
  4. Get Verification (Crucial Step): You must get the form verified and signed (with a government seal) by a competent authority. This can be your Gram Sevak, Sarpanch, Patwari, Ward Member, or a Gazetted Officer. If you live in a rented house, the landlord's signature is also required in the specific section.
  5. Attach Documents: Attach photocopies of the marriage certificate, Aadhaar cards, and name deletion NOCs.
  6. Submit: Submit this complete, verified physical form bundle to your nearest eMitra center for them to upload it into the system, or directly submit it to the local Block Development Office (BDO) / Food and Civil Supplies office.
afterApplying:
After Applying — What Next?

BDO Verification

Once the online submission is complete, the application is forwarded to the local Block Development Officer (BDO) or equivalent authority for verification.

Track Application Status

Go to the eMitra dashboard, click on Master in the top menu, and select All Application Details. Select Form 1 - New Ration Card and click Search. Look at the bottom of the list to find your application. The status will show as "Pending at BDO".

Approval & Printing

Once the BDO verifies the documents, the status will update to "Approved" or "Ready for Printing," after which the physical ration card can be printed from the eMitra portal.
